description: GenUI for DeepSeek Harness: interactive UI components rendered inline in assistant replies via the dsh-ui fence — layout, charts, plots, forms, quizzes, mermaid, 3D scenes, and an action event loop back to the model. Ships the fence-teaching host plugin, the browser renderer (client half), and the genui skill.

latest_release.name: GenUI 0.16.0
latest_release.body:
GenUI 0.16.0 新增更完整的编辑、选择与图解交互，并支持 DSH `0.2.2-rc.1`。

### 新增与改进

- 新增 `compare` 图片对比、`choices` 丰富选项与本地判卷。
- 新增 `editor` 编辑器、`entity-card` 实体卡片、`popover` 浮层、`date-picker` 日期选择与 `segmented-control` 分段选项。
- `diagram` 支持节点选择、键盘操作、节点详情与字段联动；`when` / `disabledWhen` 提供条件显示与禁用，隐藏字段不提交。
- 容器内完整子项和表格行可提前呈现，骨架屏根据已知结构显示；移除固定组件配额和强制触发规则。
- 新增表格按列换行，并修复中文排版、深色图解对比度、步骤角标、逗号小数及面板校验与恢复。

### DSH 兼容与验证

- 将精确 npm 宿主的接口、完整测试、构建和安装包浏览器验收更新到 DSH `0.2.2-rc.1`，覆盖正文渲染、图片选择、计算字段提交与 Linux 地图交互。
- 保留最低宿主、此前 RC 与 `0.2.2-alpha.2` 检查；第三方侧栏仍在 `0.2.1-rc.3` 上验收。
- DSH 当前 RC 与 alpha 宿主要求 **Node.js >=24.9.0**。

自动会话验收使用官方本地回放；真实模型账户、Android 真机和原 Windows Desktop 环境的验收仍需单独完成。

感谢 @wang-kaopu 与 @sunxiuguo 的组件、交互和修复贡献；原有提交与署名保留。

[完整更新记录](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-genui/blob/v0.16.0/CHANGELOG.md)

detail.readme:
Generative UI for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
Interactive, rich components rendered inline alongside the model's textual responses.

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@changfenhuang/dsh-genui.svg?style=flat-square&color=3B82F6)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@changfenhuang/dsh-genui) [![DSH Compatibility](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-^0.2.0--rc.1%20||%20^0.2.1--rc.1%20||%20^0.2.2--alpha.2-10B981?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-genui) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-amber.svg?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-Ready-blue?style=flat-square&logo=typescript)](https://www.typescriptlang.org/) [![Topic: dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/ecosystem-dsh--plugin-purple?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

English · 简体中文

🌐 Live Product Site · 🎬 Real Demo · 🚀 Quick Start · 🧩 Feature Matrix · 📖 Component Syntax (SKILL.md)

--- GenUI turns DeepSeek Harness (DSH) assistant replies into **safe, fully interactive UI surfaces**. > [!IMPORTANT] > Install GenUI using the full npm package name **`@changfenhuang/dsh-genui`**. See [Quick Start](#-quick-start) for setup. Ask “How are this month’s orders doing?”, and instead of plain text or raw code blocks, the response streams out an **interactive sortable data table**, **audio/video players**, **draggable function plots**, **self-grading quizzes**, or a **persistent workspace dock** — all embedded seamlessly within the conversation. --- ## 🎬 Real Interface Showcase > [!NOTE] > **Real Interface Captures:** All recordings and screenshots below are captured directly from real DSH interface rendering — no conceptual mockups or faked pre-renders. ### 40-Second Walkthrough
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f5db33ec-7471-4d4a-a85b-79c9962ab4ef


(Click the thumbnail to download the original MP4 if the GitHub video player fails to load. The prompt sequence is documented in demo-prompts.md.)

### Three Concrete Real Outputs | 1. Monitoring Panel: Answer is the Dashboard | 2. Function Plot: Drag to Redraw Instantly | 3. Composable Hierarchy: Work Surface | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | ![Monitoring Panel](./assets/showcase-panel.png) | ![Function Plot](./assets/showcase-plot.png) | ![Composable Hierarchy](./assets/showcase.png) | | **Data Insights:** Eyebrow stats, filterable/drill-down service table, grouped totals, and spark/ring cells directly live in the assistant reply. | **Zero-Latency Exploration:** `plot` draws mathematical curves; drag parameter sliders to re-calculate and redraw locally in real time. | **Structured Hierarchy:** Display quotes, stat cards, ring progress, and labeled chapter dividers composed declaratively by the model. | --- ## ✨ Before vs. After | Scenario | Plain Text Response | With dsh-genui | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Business Overview** | “Revenue this month is ¥128,430 (+12.4% MoM); conversion rate is slightly dipping…” | One line of concise prose + 3 stat cards (revenue/orders/conversion), a trend chart, and a progress bar rendered right beside it. | | **Data Exploration** | Type another prompt to ask the model to re-sort or filter. | Click table headers to **sort numbers locally**, or use the search box to filter rows in real time. | | **Parameter Tuning** | Re-prompt the model and wait for another full generation. | Drag sliders to see curves update in **sub-millisecond speed** with animation preview. | | **Next Actions** | Copy text and manually perform follow-up tasks elsewhere. | Click interactive action buttons (e.g. “Refresh”, “Switch View”) to trigger **bidirectional model event loops**. | --- ## 🚀 Quick Start ### 1. Prerequisites Ensure your environment meets the following requirements: - **DSH Version**: `^0.2.0-rc.1 || ^0.2.1-rc.1 || ^0.2.2-alpha.2`. Packed browser acceptance covers `0.2.0-rc.1`, `0.2.1-rc.3` and the exact npm hosts `0.2.2-rc.1` (current `latest` / `next`) and `0.2.2-alpha.2`; `0.2.1-rc.4` and `0.2.1-rc.5` retain separate public-API, full-unit-suite and build checks. The current RC and alpha hosts require **Node.js >=24.9.0**. Its gallery, computed-field and Map acceptance uses official local replay; third-party sidebar integration is checked on rc.3. - **pnpm on PATH**: The `dsh plugin` CLI requires pnpm. If missing: run `corepack enable` or `npm i -g pnpm`, then **open a new terminal** and confirm `pnpm -v` prints a version number. ### 2. Install & Activate Run a single command in your terminal (all dependencies are fetched automatically): ```sh # Public npm package (works without an npm account) dsh plugin --profile web add @changfenhuang/dsh-genui ``` > [!TIP] > **Adding only as a Node package?** Run `npm install @changfenhuang/dsh-genui`. Note that `npm install` only adds the dependency and does not register the plugin with DSH; use the `dsh plugin add` command above for DSH integration. ### 3. Verify in 60 Seconds 1. Restart the DSH web service and **hard refresh** your browser (`Cmd + Shift + R` or `Ctrl + F5`). 2. In a **new conversation session**, send: ```text Use dsh-ui to draw a stats dashboard with a sortable service table. ``` 3. **Expected result**: The reply renders an in-place interactive dashboard rather than a plain code block. 4. **Console activation check**: Open your browser Developer Tools Console and look for `[genui] client active; fence-channel=dom`. --- > [!WARNING] > ### ⚠️ Installation Pitfalls to Avoid > > 1. **Do Not Use `link:` on a Freshly Cloned Directory**: > `link:` alone does not bundle or resolve peer assets (mermaid, three.js, React). Use npm for standard usage; reserve `link:` strictly for local development (see [Developer Guide](#-developer-guide)). > 2. **Migrating from Legacy `@omdsh-dev`**: > If you installed from GitHub or the old org name before v0.9.2, clean up the stale key: > ```sh > dsh plugin --profile web remove @omdsh-dev/dsh-genui > dsh plugin --profile web add @changfenhuang/dsh-genui > ``` --- ## 🧩 Capability Matrix Every component and behavior is guarded by the strict `dsh-ui` specification. See [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) for full JSON schema details. ``` dsh-genui Capabilities ├── 🌊 1. Streaming & Realtime Mounting ├── 🎨 2. 30+ Component Ecosystem ├── ⚡ 3. Local-First Responsiveness ├── 🔄 4. Bidirectional Action Event Loop ├── 📌 5. Persistent Session Workspace & Templates └── 🛡️ 6. Sandboxing, Guards & Self-Healing ``` ### 1. 🌊 Streaming & Realtime Mounting - **Answer-as-UI**: Components stream into the conversation as tokens arrive, mounting incrementally without waiting for the full reply to finish. - **Graceful Fallback**: If the plugin is absent or disabled, fences degrade cleanly to standard Markdown code blocks without breaking the chat history. ### 2. 🎨 30+ Component Ecosystem - **Display & Typography**: Hero banner, Stat cards (`stat` with eyebrow labels, deltas, and sparklines), Tables, Timelines, Code Diffs, Step progress, File trees (interactive expand/collapse), Callouts, and Badges. - **Content Font Size**: Card typography grows with the host's Appearance → Content Font Size setting above 17px. At 17px or below, each component keeps its existing size. Standalone HTML exports keep their existing sizes. - **Advanced Tables**: - Click headers to **sort locally** (ascending / descending / reset) with smart parsing for numbers, currency, commas, percentages, and `k/m/b` units; - Columns support inline progress bars (`bar`), rings (`ring`), sparklines (`spark`), and badges; - One-click data export (Copy Markdown / CSV) and instant client-side text filtering (`filter`). - **ECharts Integration (`echart`)**: - **Preset Mode**: Shorthand presets (`bar`, `line`, `area`, `pie`, `scatter`, `radar`, `gauge`, `funnel`, `treemap`, `sankey`, `graph`, `heatmap`, `bigline`, `wordCloud`) that adapt automatically to host light/dark themes; - **Full Option Mode**: Full native ECharts options for advanced features like DataZoom and VisualMap; - **On-Demand Lazy Loading**: The ~1 MB ECharts engine is loaded asynchronously only when an `echart` block is encountered. - **Mathematical Function Plots (`plot`)**: - Multi-series plotting with expressions (trig, log, exp, power); - **Live Parameter Sliders**: Drag sliders to redraw curves instantly at 60 FPS; supports auto-animation loops. - **Mermaid & 3D Visuals**: Flowcharts, sequence diagrams, and lightweight 3D models with on-demand asset loading. A rendered Mermaid diagram opens a zoomable SVG dialog on click: wheel zoom, drag pan, zoom/reset controls, Esc, Close or backdrop to close with focus restored. - **Native Galleries**: `carousel` composes existing cards and forms in a responsive, keyboard-navigable horizontal track; `image-group` opens images in a local lightbox with focus restoration. Navigation does not invoke model actions. [Examples and verification](docs/gallery.md). - **Native Media**: Inline playback for accessible audio and video URLs, with poster images, aspect ratios, and controls; a single `image` opens a zoom dialog on click and returns focus to the picture when it closes. - **KaTeX Math Rendering**: Inline math (`$...$`) and display blocks (`$$...$$`), supporting matrices and multi-line equations. ### 3. ⚡ Local-First Responsiveness - **Zero-Latency Interactions**: State transitions that the frontend can handle alone (sorting, filtering, accordion toggling, slider redraws, tab switches) execute **entirely client-side** without round-trips to the model. - **Quizzes & Submission (`quiz` / `submit`)**: - Single quizzes evaluate instantly with explanations and retry options; - Multi-question assessments support batch grading and progress tracking with the `groups` schema. - **Durable Persistence**: User inputs, form fields, and quiz states persist across page reloads via session fingerprints (LRU cache of 200 blocks). ### 4. 🔄 Bidirectional Action Event Loop - **Closed-Loop Interactions**: Interactive elements equipped with an `action` payload package user events back to the model to trigger follow-up reasoning. - **Honest UI Guarantee**: Buttons without an `action` render disabled to eliminate "dead clicks"; active buttons show immediate visual feedback upon trigger. - **Debounced Delivery**: Discrete taps send immediately; continuous slider drags apply trailing-edge debounce to prevent message flooding. ### 5. 📌 Persistent Session Workspace & Templates - **Session Dock Panel**: Open a persistent dock above the composer via `/panel` or `panel: true`; resize by dragging its border; append tabs incrementally with `append: true`. - **Template Center & Badges**: - **Templates**: Browse 11 pre-built scenario templates directly from the dock to kickstart prompts; - **Achievements**: Unlock 12 built-in local exploration badges as you interact with various components. ### 6. 🛡️ Sandboxing, Guards & Self-Healing - **Security by Design**: Strictly whitelisted JSON components; zero script injection or `eval`; **strict prohibition of passwords or secret collection**. - **Same-Turn Fence Steering**: If a generated fence fails validation, diagnostic errors are fed back to the model within the **same turn** so it can self-correct (can be disabled via `fenceFeedback: false`). - **Resilient Fallbacks**: Malformed nodes are safely discarded while siblings render normally (single node errors never crash the fence); Mermaid syntax glitches are automatically repaired. --- ## 💻 Quick Examples ### Example 1: Executive KPI Dashboard The model emits the following `dsh-ui` code block: ```dsh-ui { "title": "Q3 2026 Executive Overview", "items": [ { "type": "row", "items": [ { "type": "stat", "label": "Total Revenue", "value": "¥128,430", "delta": "+12.4%", "spark": [40, 55, 60, 85, 120] }, { "type": "stat", "label": "Completed Orders", "value": "1,024", "delta": "-3.1%", "spark": [90, 85, 80, 75, 70] }, { "type": "progress", "label": "Quarterly Target", "value": 82, "variant": "ring" } ] } ] } ``` ### Example 2: ECharts Revenue Trend ```dsh-ui { "title": "Revenue Breakdown", "items": [ { "type": "echart", "title": "Monthly Performance", "preset": "bar", "data": [ { "label": "Jan", "value": 98 }, { "label": "Feb", "value": 112 }, { "label": "Mar", "value": 128 }, { "label": "Apr", "value": 145 }, { "label": "May", "value": 160 } ] } ] } ``` > For the comprehensive specification and full component catalog, refer to [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md). --- ## ⚙️ Architecture & How It Works ```mermaid sequenceDiagram autonumber actor User as User participant Host as DSH Host / LLM participant DOM as Conversation DOM participant GenUI as GenUI Client Renderer participant Assets as On-Demand Assets (ECharts/Three) User->>Host: Prompt (e.g. "Analyze recent order trends") Host-->>DOM: Streams Markdown prose & ```dsh-ui fence DOM->>GenUI: Detects fence and normalizes schema against whitelist alt Requires Heavy Engines GenUI->>Assets: Dynamically fetches engine bundles Assets-->>GenUI: Assets loaded end GenUI->>DOM: Mounts React component tree incrementally opt Client-Side Local Actions User->>GenUI: Sort table / Drag plot slider / Answer quiz GenUI-->>User: Instant sub-millisecond local update end opt Model Action Feedback User->>GenUI: Click interactive action button GenUI->>Host: Dispatches structured action payload Host-->>DOM: Model responds with next-step reasoning / updates panel end ``` ### Artifact Exporting Completed GenUI blocks can be exported on demand: - **Standalone `.html`**: Inlines the lightweight renderer, CSS styles, KaTeX fonts, required chart engines, and the same-origin images it can read so the interactive UI can be viewed and tested offline in any browser. - **`.genui.json`**: Retains the normalized specification and durable interaction states for storage and portability. --- ## 🧑‍💻 Developer Guide ### Local Development (Link Mode) ```sh git clone https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-genui.git cd dsh-genui pnpm install # Build and link into your DSH web profile dsh plugin --profile web add link:$PWD ``` ### Useful Commands ```sh pnpm run check # Type checks + full unit test suite + build pnpm run test # Run Vitest unit tests pnpm run check:host-api dsh-v0.2.1-rc.3 # Check the retained rc.3 host API pnpm run check:host-api dsh-v0.2.1-rc.4 # Check the earlier rc.4 API pnpm run check:host-api dsh-v0.2.1-rc.5 # Check the earlier rc.5 API, full suite and build pnpm run check:host-api dsh-v0.2.2-rc.1 # Check the current npm latest / next API, full suite and build pnpm run check:host-api dsh-v0.2.2-alpha.2 # Check the supported npm alpha API, full suite and build node scripts/verify-pack.mjs --keep # Verify and inspect npm tarball ``` ### End-to-End (E2E) Testing CI and the release workflow install `0.2.2-alpha.2` from npm with `node scripts/prepare-published-host.mjs 0.2.2-alpha.2`, then verify the packed plugin in a fresh web profile. This lane uses `DSH_HOST_LAYOUT=registry` and `DSH_HOST_VERSION=0.2.2-alpha.2` with the returned `DSH_ROOT` and `DSH_BIN`; the source-host lanes remain pinned to their official tags. The same registry-host lane also installs `0.2.2-rc.1`, with `DSH_HOST_VERSION=0.2.2-rc.1`. Registry-host checks pin Cordis framework dependencies to the versions recorded in each host’s published manifest so later dependency resolution cannot change the host graph. Both current RC and alpha API, gallery/computed and Linux Map checks must pass before npm publication. Actions use official local replay; Android device and original Windows Desktop acceptance remain separate. - **Visual E2E Smoke (No Model API Key Required)**: ```sh npx tsx scripts/e2e-visual.mts # Boots headless Chrome, tests gallery rendering and asserts interactions ``` - **Real-Model Integration E2E**: ```sh export DSH_ROOT=/path/to/deepseek-harness-0.2.1-rc.3 export DSH_BIN="$DSH_ROOT/apps/cli/lib/bin.js" DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... node scripts/e2e.mjs ``` ### Advanced Profile Configurations To customize plugin behaviors, add configurations under `cordis.patch.yml` in your profile: ```yaml - id: genui name: '@changfenhuang/dsh-genui' config: renderUiTool: false # Disable registering the render_ui tool card (fences and panel remain active) fenceFeedback: false # Disable automatic same-turn steer correction on malformed fences fenceSection: full # full (default), minimal, or false ``` `fenceSection` controls both fence guidance detail and usage preference: | Mode | Behavior | | --- | --- | | `full` (default) | Provides syntax and essential rules, and proactively uses components for comparisons along shared dimensions, numerical trends, process dependencies, and user interaction, without waiting for a reminder. | | `minimal` | Keeps only the fence example and the requirement to load the GenUI skill; user instructions determine usage preference. | | `false` | Omits the `genui:fence` section. | Requirement words follow [RFC 2119](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2119): valid JSON, current fields, and explicit user language and presentation requirements are MUST rules. In `full`, using appropriate UI for comparisons, trends, dependencies, and interaction is SHOULD guidance; card wrappers are MAY. `full` sets no list-length trigger or component quota. Ordinary explanations and short lists default to prose. Modes guide behavior rather than guaranteeing a fixed usage rate. Use fences for inline reply content, `render_ui` for a standalone UI in the tool result, and `panel:true` for the session panel that updates in place. Both fences and tools preserve interaction state; choose by placement. `card` is an optional container: avoiding unnecessary card wrappers does not mean avoiding GenUI. Skill availability is resolved in the current agent's tool view, including preset-owned loaders; a global `skill` registration is not required. The visible tool must expose the Skill loader contract, and `genui` must allow model invocation. When the skill already includes current fields, no component reference is injected. An older skill receives only missing or changed field descriptions in `genui:reference`; appended user preferences do not trigger a full reference. User skill files remain untouched, and current system fields take precedence over loaded older fields. If a compatible loader or model-invocable GenUI skill is unavailable, a compact field reference is supplied for fence guidance or an available `render_ui` tool. `fenceSection: false` omits fence guidance; disabling both fence guidance and `render_ui` also omits the reference. Neither setting disables fence rendering or panels. The dsh-go `genui:native` section and tool definitions have independent guidance and token costs. Loading the full skill for an actual UI response still consumes context; this change removes the unconditional duplicate catalog rather than making that load free. ### Embedding into Other Applications You can import `GenuiBlock`, `GenuiActionContext`, and `processGenuiSpec` from `@changfenhuang/dsh-genui/embed` to embed the renderer into any React application supporting CSS Modules. ### dsh-go integration The dsh-go integration uses the App’s existing native cards, inline choices and plugin panels; no App patch or replacement APK is needed. The complete web spec stays authoritative. Native panels support choices, switches, buttons, submissions, local grading, tabs, accordions, copy and confirmed HTTPS links. Validation can produce one JSON fence readable by both renderers. Panels currently require the local-engine dsh-go bridge; SSH and relay hosts retain native tool cards. Advanced graphics and free-text input remain explicit limitations. See [capabilities and verification](docs/dsh-go.md). ### Theming: non-opaque host canvases Every surface resolves through one chain: `--dsl-g-surface` → `--dsh-genui-surface` → `--dsw-alias-bg-layer-2` → … → `#fff`. A skin that paints the page itself (wallpaper, glass / translucent look) can pin the surface once without touching the host's own tokens: ```css :root { --dsh-genui-surface: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.58); } body[data-ds-dark-theme] { --dsh-genui-surface: rgba(32, 32, 34, 0.54); } ``` `callout` and toned `card` washes are painted *over* that surface, so they stay readable on any canvas. `card.flat` and `table` are surface-less by design (a printed block, a bare data grid) and would show a non-opaque page through — they fill only when a skin asks for it: ```css :root { --dsh-genui-surface: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.58); /* cards, callouts, controls */ --dsh-genui-surface-flat: var(--dsh-genui-surface); /* card.flat */ --dsh-genui-surface-table: var(--dsh-genui-surface); /* table */ } ``` Leaving the last two unset keeps today's look (transparent table, 2.5% printed flat card); pointing them at `var(--dsh-genui-surface)` gives all three one fill. Wrapping a table in a `card` fills it too, since the parent surface shows through (issue #398). --- ### Sidechat surfaces (optional) GenUI can render settled `dsh-ui` fences on provider-declared sidechat surfaces. BetterSidebar uses its `registerSidechatSurfaceAdapter` capability; other providers can expose the optional `genuiSidechat` Cordis service. Each surface carries its owning thread identity and prompt callback, so actions and interaction state stay within that child thread. Streaming rows and unsupported or invalid fences keep their original Markdown. See [the sidechat surface adapter contract](docs/sidechat-surfaces.md). BetterSidebar support requires a release containing [its provider implementation](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar/pull/1033); the released 0.28.0 does not expose `registerSidechatSurfaceAdapter`. The DSH native Side Chat provider must expose `genuiSidechat` to enable this integration. ## ❓ FAQ & Troubleshooting
Q: Why are dsh-ui fences still showing up as raw code blocks? 1. Open your browser Developer Tools (F12) and inspect the Console. 2. Search for the log `[genui] client active; fence-channel=dom`: - **If missing**: The client bundle was not activated by the host. Verify that `dsh plugin list` shows the plugin as active, restart DSH web, and hard refresh your browser; - **If present**: Check whether the code block language identifier is strictly `dsh-ui` and that its body contains valid JSON.
Q: Error: "pnpm not found on PATH"? DSH plugin management calls `pnpm` under the hood. Run `corepack enable` or `npm i -g pnpm`, then **open a new terminal window** before running `dsh plugin add`.
Q: npm install returns 404? The package is public and requires no login. Verify the package name via `npm view @changfenhuang/dsh-genui version`. If a version was published very recently, allow a few moments for registry mirrors to synchronize.
Q: 3D scene, Mermaid, or ECharts does not render? Heavier engines are lazy-loaded through plugin-provided static routes upon their first appearance. Hard refresh your browser (`Cmd + Shift + R`). If the issue persists, reinstall the package: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove @changfenhuang/dsh-genui dsh plugin --profile web add @changfenhuang/dsh-genui ```
Q: The chat screen goes blank when rendering a fence? This version requires DSH `^0.2.0-rc.1 || ^0.2.1-rc.1 || ^0.2.2-alpha.2`. Older host versions lack necessary React slot/context capabilities; please upgrade DSH.
--- ## 🗺️ Roadmap Evaluation | Exploration Area | Decision | Rationale | | :--- | :---: | :--- | | **Incremental Diff Patching** | Declined | A fence costs only 200–800 tokens; resending is fast and safe. Teaching models a patch diff protocol introduces high friction and hallucination rates. | | **Granular Action Delivery** | ✅ Done | Discrete gestures send immediately; continuous slider drags apply trailing-edge debounce to keep chat context clean. | | **Cross-Session Replay Persistence** | Declined | Resetting on replay is the more natural expectation when the model updates the UI; state is preserved seamlessly during streaming. | | **Separate Gallery / i18n Strings** | Declined | The component gallery is covered by `demo-prompts`, `gallery.ts`, and README screenshots; the core bundle carries only 6 built-in UI strings. | --- ## 🔗 Links & Community - [Linux.do Community Discussion](https://linux.do) - Visit the [Live Product Site](https://omdsh-dev.github.io/dsh-genui/) to explore more demos. --- ## 📄 License This project is licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE). ### Interactive maps The `map` node combines lazy MapLibre markers and inline routes with an always-available keyboard-operable location list. Selection stays local and can be persisted/submitted as a stable location ID through the existing fields contract. The default is an offline blank coordinate map, not a street basemap; external styles belong to trusted host configuration, never model JSON. See [the map contract and embedding/export guide](docs/map.md).

--- GenUI 将大模型的文本回答无缝升级为**安全、可交互的原生 DSH 界面**。 > [!IMPORTANT] > 安装 GenUI 时请使用完整 npm 包名 **`@changfenhuang/dsh-genui`**。安装步骤见[快速开始](#-快速开始)。 例如当你询问「这个月订单表现如何？」，模型给出的回答不再只是一串文字，而是边打字边在正文中展开一张**可排序的数据面板**、一段**内嵌音视频**、一个**可拖拽调参的函数图像**、一组**即时判卷的测验**，或是一个**常驻的会话工作区**——文本与 UI 和谐共存，浑然一体。 --- ## 🎬 真实界面预览 > [!NOTE] > **真实截图与录屏：** 以下界面素材均直接截取自 DSH 真实对话环境中的渲染结果，无任何概念样机或预渲染伪造。 ### 40 秒完整体验

### 回答中的三类典型输出 | 1. 监控面板：回答即仪表盘 | 2. 探索绘图：本地即时重绘 | 3. 结构排版：构建工作界面 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | ![监控面板](./assets/showcase-panel.png) | ![函数图](./assets/showcase-plot.png) | ![排版与卡片](./assets/showcase.png) | | **数据洞察：** 指标卡（Eyebrow）、可筛选可钻取的服务表、分组合计与 Spark/Ring 单元格直接内嵌在回答中。 | **即时交互：** `plot` 绘制数学曲线；拖动参数滑块在浏览器端实时重绘，零模型往返延迟。 | **层级工作区：** 标题引言、指标卡片、环形进度与章节分隔线，由模型声明式灵活编排。 | --- ## ✨ 对比：装之前 vs 装之后 | 场景 | 传统纯文本回答 | 安装 dsh-genui 之后 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **业务监控** | “本月收入 ¥128,430，环比 +12.4%，转化率稍有下滑……” | 一行文字分析 + 紧贴正文的**收入/订单/转化率指标卡**、**动态趋势图**与**进度条**。 | | **数据筛选** | 必须再发送一段提问要求模型重新生成表格。 | 表格自带**本地点击排序**与**实时过滤框**，无需重新请求模型。 | | **深入探索** | 想要调整参数看趋势，必须反复调用模型对话。 | 拖动参数滑块，函数曲线在前端**毫秒级重绘**，带播放动画演示。 | | **后续操作** | 复制文本自己另找工具处理。 | 面板自带「刷新」「切换视图」按钮，点击通过 **Action 闭环**驱动模型执行下一步。 | --- ## 🚀 快速开始 ### 1. 环境准备 安装前请确认满足以下条件： - **DSH 版本**：`^0.2.0-rc.1 || ^0.2.1-rc.1 || ^0.2.2-alpha.2`。安装包浏览器验收覆盖 `0.2.0-rc.1`、`0.2.1-rc.3` 与 npm 精确安装的 `0.2.2-rc.1`（当前 `latest` / `next`）和 `0.2.2-alpha.2`；`0.2.1-rc.4` 与 `0.2.1-rc.5` 继续单独执行公开接口、完整单元测试与构建检查。当前 RC 与 alpha 宿主要求 **Node.js >=24.9.0**，图片集合、计算字段和地图使用官方本地回放验收；第三方侧栏接入在 rc.3 上验收。 - **pnpm 处于 PATH 中**：`dsh plugin` 底层依赖 pnpm。如尚未安装，请执行 `corepack enable` 或 `npm i -g pnpm`，之后**重新打开终端**，确认 `pnpm -v` 可正常输出。 ### 2. 一键安装与激活 在终端中执行以下命令（一键全自动拉取依赖）： ```sh # 安装并激活至 DSH web profile（公开包，无需登录 npm） dsh plugin --profile web add @changfenhuang/dsh-genui ``` > [!TIP] > **仅作为依赖引入？** 若仅作为 Node 项目依赖引入而不注入 DSH 宿主，执行 `npm install @changfenhuang/dsh-genui` 即可。 ### 3. 60 秒验证 1. 重启 DSH web 服务，并在浏览器中执行**硬刷新**（`Cmd + Shift + R` 或 `Ctrl + F5`）。 2. 在 DSH 中开启一个**新会话**，发送以下指令： ```text 用 dsh-ui 画一个带可排序服务表的统计看板。 ``` 3. **预期效果**：回答中的代码块将实时转变为精美的交互式仪表盘，而非原样文本。 4. **控制台激活检测**：打开浏览器开发者工具 Console，若看到输出 `[genui] client active; fence-channel=dom`，说明客户端已成功激活。 --- > [!WARNING] > ### ⚠️ 安装避坑指南 > > 1. **切勿使用 `link:` 安装刚 git clone 的目录**： > 纯 `link:` 不会自动安装 Mermaid、Three.js、React 等对等依赖，导致前端渲染报错。日常使用请走 npm 安装；仅本地源码开发时才使用 link（见[开发者指南](#-开发者指南)）。 > 2. **从旧包名 `@omdsh-dev` 迁移**： > 若在 v0.9.2 之前使用过 GitHub 源或旧组织名安装，请执行： > ```sh > dsh plugin --profile web remove @omdsh-dev/dsh-genui > dsh plugin --profile web add @changfenhuang/dsh-genui > ``` --- ## 🧩 核心能力全景 `dsh-genui` 的所有组件与交互受严格的白名单规范约束，兼顾丰富表现力与高安全性。完整字段定义见 [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md)。 ``` dsh-genui 核心能力矩阵 ├── 🌊 1. 边流边渲染 (Streaming UI) ├── 🎨 2. 30+ 丰富组件生态 (Components Matrix) ├── ⚡ 3. 本地优先即时交互 (Local-First Experience) ├── 🔄 4. 闭环事件回传系统 (Action Event-Loop) ├── 📌 5. 常驻会话工作台 (Session Panel & Templates) └── 🛡️ 6. 安全沙箱与容错自愈 (Safety & Self-Healing) ``` ### 1. 🌊 边流边渲染 (Streaming UI) - **回答即界面**：组件内嵌在回复正文中，跟随模型 Token 流式吐出，边生成边即时挂载，**无需等待整段回复输出完毕**。 - **零破坏降级**：若未安装或禁用插件，`dsh-ui` 围栏将退回为优雅的 Markdown 代码块，绝不破坏会话内容。 ### 2. 🎨 30+ 丰富组件生态 (Components Matrix) - **展示与排版**：包含指标卡（`stat`，支持 Hero 超大字号与微趋势线 Sparkline）、表格（`table`）、时间线（`timeline`）、代码对比（`diff`）、步骤条（`steps`）、文件树（`file-tree`，支持点击展开折叠）、提示卡（`callout`）、徽章（`badge`）等。 - **内容字号**：卡片字号会随宿主「设置 → 外观 → 内容字号」增大；宿主设置为 17px 或更小时保留各组件原有字号。独立导出的 HTML 保留原有字号。 - **高级表格**： - 点击表头**纯本地排序**（升序/降序/还原，支持千分位、百分比、货币及万/亿数值感知）； - 单元格支持 `bar` 进度条、`ring` 环形、`spark` 趋势线，带正负符号数值自动着色； - 一键支持数据导出（复制 Markdown / CSV）与即时文本过滤（Filter）。 - **ECharts 深度集成 (`echart`)**： - **预设简写模式**（`preset`）：支持 `bar`、`line`、`area`、`pie`、`scatter`、`radar`、`gauge`、`funnel`、`treemap`、`sankey`、`graph`、`heatmap`、`bigline`、`wordCloud` 等数十种图形，配色自动匹配 DSH 主题； - **完整配置模式**（`option`）：支持原生 ECharts 选项，轻松开启 DataZoom、VisualMap 等高级特性； - **按需异步加载**：ECharts 引擎（~1MB）独立打包，未调用图表组件的会话绝不加载多余代码。 - **数学函数绘图 (`plot`)**： - 支持多曲线绘制（line / area / scatter），公式支持三角函数、对数、幂运算等； - **动态参数滑块**：拖动滑块前端毫秒级重绘，锁定 Y 轴，支持自动动画循环演示。 - **Mermaid & 3D 场景**：支持流程图、序列图及轻量 3D 模型渲染，引擎按需异步加载。渲染完成的 Mermaid 图可点击打开原生对话框查看大图：滚轮缩放、拖拽平移、工具栏放大/缩小/重置，Esc、关闭按钮或点遮罩退出并把焦点放回图表。 - **原生多媒体**：支持浏览器可直达的音频（`audio`）与视频（`video`）嵌入播放，包含封面图、比例自适应及播放控制。 - **数学公式集成**：基于 KaTeX，支持行内公式 `$...$`、块级公式 `$$...$$`，支持矩阵与多行推导。 ### 3. ⚡ 本地优先即时交互 (Local-First Experience) - **本地优先原则**：前端界面能够独立完成的操作（表格排序、过滤、内容展开/收起、标签切换、参数重绘、测验判题），**一律在浏览器本地即时完成**，绝不进行不必要的模型往返。 - **测验与本地判卷 (`quiz` / `submit`)**： - 单题测验点击即在本地判题、展示解析并支持重试； - 多题问卷/表单可通过 `submit` 统一交卷，支持 `groups` 必填项控制与进度感知。 - **状态持久化**：表单输入、单选多选与测验进度基于「会话 + 内容指纹」自动存入缓存（LRU 200 块），刷新页面或重开会话无缝恢复。 ### 4. 🔄 闭环事件回传系统 (Action Event-Loop) - **真实动作闭环**：当按钮或表单带上 `action` 字段时，用户的点击或提交会即时组装为结构化事件回传给大模型，触发下一轮智能分析。 - **诚实交互设计**：未声明 `action` 的按钮自动渲染为禁用态，杜绝“看起来可点但无反应”的假交互；点击有效按钮触发即刻给予视觉反馈。 - **智能防抖**：按钮与切换项单次手势单次发送，连续滑块拖动自动开启尾沿防抖，仅回传最终停顿值。 ### 5. 📌 常驻会话工作台 (Session Panel & Templates) - **常驻 Dock 面板**：支持通过 `/panel` 指令或 `panel: true` 将 UI 固化在输入框上方；支持鼠标拖拽边框调整高度；支持 `append: true` 增量追加标签页。 - **模板中心与成就系统**： - **模板中心**：点击 Dock 顶部的「模板」即可预览 11 类典型业务场景模板，一键插词唤起模型； - **探索成就**：内置 12 项探索趣味成就，本地计数记录使用足迹。 ### 6. 🛡️ 安全沙箱与容错自愈 (Safety & Self-Healing) - **严格安全防线**：所有组件严格受白名单结构约束，杜绝一切外部代码注入与 `eval` 执行；**严禁索取与收集密码、API Key 等任何敏感凭据**，密码类输入强制打码且绝不持久化。 - **同回合轮内自修 (Fence Steer Repair)**：若模型生成的 `dsh-ui` 围栏存在格式缺陷，插件自动捕获错误并在**同一回合内**将精确节点诊断反馈给模型，触发自主纠正与重发（可配置 `fenceFeedback: false` 关闭）。 - **节点级自愈降级**：单个语法异常节点被静默舍弃，同级其他正常组件继续完好渲染，绝不因个别节点错误拖垮整屏界面；Mermaid 常见语法缺陷自动修复重试。 --- ## 💻 快速示例 ### 示例 1：核心业务指标看板 模型在正文中输出以下 `dsh-ui` 围栏（规范化 JSON）： ```dsh-ui { "title": "2026 Q3 业务运行概览", "items": [ { "type": "row", "items": [ { "type": "stat", "label": "总营收", "value": "¥128,430", "delta": "+12.4%", "spark": [40, 55, 60, 85, 120] }, { "type": "stat", "label": "支付订单数", "value": "1,024", "delta": "-3.1%", "spark": [90, 85, 80, 75, 70] }, { "type": "progress", "label": "季度目标完成率", "value": 82, "variant": "ring" } ] } ] } ``` ### 示例 2：ECharts 丰富折线与柱状图 ```dsh-ui { "title": "月度营收走势分析", "items": [ { "type": "echart", "title": "2026 上半年走势", "preset": "bar", "data": [ { "label": "1月", "value": 98 }, { "label": "2月", "value": 112 }, { "label": "3月", "value": 128 }, { "label": "4月", "value": 145 }, { "label": "5月", "value": 160 } ] } ] } ``` > 更多高级组件（函数绘图、表格排序过滤、测验表单等）的完整协议规范，请参阅 [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md)。 --- ## ⚙️ 架构与运行机制 ```mermaid sequenceDiagram autonumber actor User as 用户 participant Host as DSH 宿主 / 大模型 participant DOM as DSH 对话 DOM participant GenUI as GenUI 客户端渲染器 participant Assets as 动态资产服务 (ECharts/Three) User->>Host: 提问（例如："分析近期订单趋势"） Host-->>DOM: 流式输出 Markdown 正文与 ```dsh-ui 围栏 DOM->>GenUI: 捕获围栏节点并进行白名单结构规范化 alt 依赖重型图表引擎 GenUI->>Assets: 动态按需加载引擎脚本 Assets-->>GenUI: 注入完成 end GenUI->>DOM: 原地挂载独立 React 组件树，实时流式上屏 opt 本地即时交互 User->>GenUI: 点击表单排序 / 拖动函数滑块 / 答题判卷 GenUI-->>User: 毫秒级即时前端重绘与状态持久化 end opt 触发闭环 Action User->>GenUI: 点击触发模型交互的按钮 GenUI->>Host: 回传结构化 Action 数据流 Host-->>DOM: 模型响应下一轮分析或更新常驻 Panel end ``` ### 成果导出能力 对渲染完成的 GenUI 内容，支持点击菜单导出为： - **独立 `.html`**：内嵌渲染核心、样式、KaTeX 字体、所用图表引擎，以及导出时能读到的同源图片，脱离 DSH 也能在任意浏览器中离线打开与交互。 - **`.genui.json`**：完整保存规范化后的 Spec 结构与持久化交互状态。 --- ## 🧑‍💻 开发者指南 ### 本地开发联调（Link 模式） ```sh git clone https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-genui.git cd dsh-genui pnpm install # 本地联调构建并软链至 DSH dsh plugin --profile web add link:$PWD ``` ### 常用命令 ```sh pnpm run check # 类型检查 + 单元测试 + 构建 pnpm run test # 运行 Vitest 测试套件 pnpm run check:host-api dsh-v0.2.1-rc.3 # 检查保留的 rc.3 宿主公开接口 pnpm run check:host-api dsh-v0.2.1-rc.4 # 检查此前的 rc.4 公开接口 pnpm run check:host-api dsh-v0.2.1-rc.5 # 检查此前的 rc.5 接口、完整测试与构建 pnpm run check:host-api dsh-v0.2.2-rc.1 # 检查当前 npm latest / next 接口、完整测试与构建 pnpm run check:host-api dsh-v0.2.2-alpha.2 # 检查受支持的 npm alpha 接口、完整测试与构建 node scripts/verify-pack.mjs --keep # 生成并打包校验 tarball ``` Windows CI 校验检出后的 `SKILL.md` 文档头和示例，并执行 `npm pack --json`。Linux CI 运行完整测试套件，包括 DOM 和 `install.sh` 测试。 ### 端到端 E2E 验证 CI 与发布任务通过 `node scripts/prepare-published-host.mjs 0.2.2-alpha.2` 从 npm 安装精确版本，在独立 web profile 中验收插件安装包。此通道使用 `DSH_HOST_LAYOUT=registry`、`DSH_HOST_VERSION=0.2.2-alpha.2` 和脚本返回的 `DSH_ROOT`、`DSH_BIN`；源码宿主通道继续固定到对应官方标签。同一 registry 通道也安装 `0.2.2-rc.1`，对应设置 `DSH_HOST_VERSION=0.2.2-rc.1`。npm 宿主验收将 Cordis 基础框架依赖固定到对应宿主发布清单所列版本，避免后续依赖解析改变测试宿主。当前 RC 与 alpha 的接口、图片集合与计算字段、Linux 地图检查全部通过后才发布 npm。动作使用官方本地回放；Android 真机及原 Windows Desktop 环境仍需单独验收。 - **视觉回归 E2E（无需模型 API Key）**： ```sh npx tsx scripts/e2e-visual.mts # 生成全量组件截图与交互验证断言 ``` - **真机闭环 E2E（调用模型真实响应）**： ```sh export DSH_ROOT=/path/to/deepseek-harness-0.2.1-rc.3 export DSH_BIN="$DSH_ROOT/apps/cli/lib/bin.js" DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... node scripts/e2e.mjs ``` ### 进阶配置项 若需自定义插件行为，可在用户 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中调整： ```yaml - id: genui name: '@changfenhuang/dsh-genui' config: renderUiTool: false # 关闭额外注入的 render_ui 工具调用，仅保留正文 dsh-ui 围栏与 panel fenceFeedback: false # 关闭模型生成失败时的同回合自动 steer 纠错 fenceSection: full # 可选 full（默认）、minimal 或 false ``` `fenceSection` 同时控制围栏提示的详略与使用倾向： | 档位 | 行为 | | --- | --- | | `full`（默认） | 提供语法和基本规则，主动用组件呈现共同维度的比较、数值趋势、流程依赖和用户交互，无需用户每次提醒。 | | `minimal` | 只保留围栏示例和加载 GenUI Skill 的要求，使用倾向由用户指令决定。 | | `false` | 不注册 `genui:fence` 提示段。 | 规则强度按 [RFC 2119](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2119) 区分：合法 JSON、当前字段规范及用户明确的语言与呈现要求属于 MUST；`full` 对比较、趋势、流程依赖和交互使用合适 UI 属于 SHOULD，可因场景合理取舍；card 容器属于 MAY。`full` 不按要点条数或回答长度触发，没有组件数量配额；普通解释和短清单默认正文。档位调整提示倾向，不保证固定触发率。 正文内联内容用围栏，工具结果区域的独立 UI 用 `render_ui`，持续更新的会话面板用 `panel:true`。围栏和工具都支持交互状态保存，按呈现位置选择。`card` 是可选容器，不默认套卡片不等于不用 GenUI。 Skill 是否可用按当前 Agent 的工具视图判断，支持预设提供的工具，不要求存在全局 `skill`。可见工具必须符合 Skill 加载接口，且 `genui` 允许模型调用。技能已包含当前字段时，不再注入组件参考；旧技能只在 `genui:reference` 中补充缺失或变化的字段说明，追加用户偏好不会触发整份参考。用户技能文件保持原样，当前系统字段优先于加载到的旧字段。 没有兼容的加载工具或允许模型调用的 GenUI 技能时，围栏指导开启或 `render_ui` 可用时，提供精简字段速查。`fenceSection: false` 关闭围栏指导；围栏指导和 `render_ui` 都关闭时，不注入参考。这些设置不禁用围栏渲染或 Panel。dsh-go 的 `genui:native` 提示段及工具定义独立计算提示与 Token 消耗。实际生成 UI 时加载完整技能仍会消耗上下文；此次移除的是无条件重复注入，并非让技能加载免费。 --- ### dsh-go 接入 dsh-go 适配使用 App 已有的原生卡片、正文选择与确认、插件面板，无需修改或重新安装 App。网页版继续读取完整的 GenUI 规格；原生面板支持选择、开关、按钮、提交、本地判卷、页签、折叠、复制和受控链接。正文围栏由验证工具生成网页与原生共用的 JSON。面板交互目前需要本机引擎提供 dsh-go 桥接；SSH、中转仍可显示原生工具卡。高级图形和自由输入等缺口会明确提示。详见[接入能力与验证范围](docs/dsh-go.md)。 ### Sidechat surface 接入（可选） GenUI 可在 provider 明确提供的 sidechat surface 上渲染已结算的 `dsh-ui` 围栏。BetterSidebar 使用现有的 `registerSidechatSurfaceAdapter` 能力；其他 provider 可提供可选的 `genuiSidechat` Cordis service。每个 surface 都携带所属线程身份和专属 prompt 回调，因此动作与交互状态留在对应子线程。流式内容及不支持或无效的围栏保留原 Markdown。 请参阅 [sidechat surface adapter 接口说明](docs/sidechat-surfaces.md)。BetterSidebar 侧边对话渲染需要包含[配套 provider 实现](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar/pull/1033)的发布版本；已发布的 0.28.0 尚未提供 `registerSidechatSurfaceAdapter`。启用 DSH 原生 Side Chat 接入需要其 provider 提供 `genuiSidechat`。 ## ❓ 常见问题排查 (FAQ)
Q: 为什么生成的 dsh-ui 仍然显示为普通代码块？ 1. 打开浏览器开发者工具（F12），切换到 Console 面板； 2. 检索是否有 `[genui] client active; fence-channel=dom` 日志： - **若没有**：说明客户端 Bundle 尚未被 DSH 宿主激活。请检查 `dsh plugin list` 确认插件已正确安装，并尝试重启 DSH web 与硬刷新浏览器； - **若已有**：检查模型输出的代码块标签是否准确为 `dsh-ui`，且内容为合法的 JSON。
Q: 提示 "pnpm not found on PATH"？ DSH 的插件管理需要调用宿主系统的 `pnpm`。请在系统终端执行 `corepack enable` 或 `npm i -g pnpm`，安装完成后**新开一个终端窗口**再执行 `dsh plugin add`。
Q: npm install 返回 404？ 本包是公开包（无需任何 npm 账号授权）。可先执行 `npm view @changfenhuang/dsh-genui version` 查看最新公开版本。若刚发布可能存在几分钟镜像同步延迟，请稍后重试。
Q: 3D 场景、Mermaid 或 ECharts 无法渲染？ 图形重型引擎采用按需加载机制（首次使用时通过插件内置的静态路由拉取）。请先硬刷新网页（`Cmd + Shift + R`）；如果仍失败，可尝试重新安装插件： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove @changfenhuang/dsh-genui dsh plugin --profile web add @changfenhuang/dsh-genui ```
Q: 渲染 dsh-ui 时界面出现白屏？ 当前版本要求 DSH `^0.2.0-rc.1 || ^0.2.1-rc.1 || ^0.2.2-alpha.2`。如运行在较老版本的 DSH 上可能存在 React 上下文兼容问题，请升级 DSH 宿主。
